rate_fields.model_id: Exact billed model id; must match the config provider.model_id
rate_fields.reasoning_usd_per_million: Optional separate reasoning rate. Omit when reasoning_billed_as is output.
rate_fields.reasoning_billed_as: output means reasoning tokens are included in completion/output tokens and billed at the output rate. Do not add a second reasoning charge.
rate_fields.cached_input_usd_per_million: Verified cached input token price when the API reports cached tokens

notes: USD totals are computed after a call from reported tokens and a matching catalog rate. Missing tokens or missing rates stay unknown; nothing is imputed.
max_estimated_budget_usd is a post-call estimated-spend stop, not a guaranteed pre-call cap. A single request can still exceed the budget. Unknown usage on any completed call blocks later calls.
Use max_requests as the hard pre-call limit. EL OpenAI configs set max_estimated_budget_usd to 1.00.
OpenAI GPT-5 family reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens. Catalog rows use reasoning_billed_as=output so the runner does not double-count them.
Only operator-verified official rates are listed. Other providers remain unpriced.
